title: The holding energy on the commissioned counter; the package as the biology folder alone
set_out: Audit FOUR_DOMAINS and the book against what was commissioned, make the researcher package a clone of the biology folder alone, and finish the mouse reproduction.
open_at_turnover: Open: the mouse reproduction (running on AWS); every other table audited the same way as FOUR_DOMAINS; the researcher-package and book Zenodo records once the audit is done.
closing: The cells' holding energy now comes from the commissioned counter at every source, and a clone of the biology folder alone runs the release check and a reproduction.

entries.title: A clone of the biology folder alone
entries.what: A partial clone of Biological_Physics only (843 MB) passed the chain v4 release check (29 of 29) and the C-Score band reproduction; no other folder came down.
entries.why: A researcher should need only the biology folder.

entries.title: The holding energy recounted on the commissioned counter
entries.what: On chain Stage Q2's counts of 153 public samples, 56 healthy cell types: holding energy 3.08 ± 0.12 kT (2.85-3.37), healthy held error 0.044, 0.147 of one ATP, healthy height 0.259 bits.
entries.why: The earlier counter divided by every CpG on a molecule, ends included, and read about 0.75 of the per-opportunity rate.

entries.title: The book check on a full clone
entries.what: 4,650 checks, 0 failures, after 35 checks were rewritten to the commissioned record and 41 that held numbers their chapters no longer print were removed.
entries.why: The laptop's partial checkout lacks the committed data files.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out
sections.lead: Each count runs through the chain.

entries.title: One energy in every cell type, on the true count too
entries.what: The spread across 56 healthy cell types stays 0.12 kT, inside the copying enzyme's measured Hopfield gap (1.9-4.4 kT); the firm rate (0.0403, 3.17 kT) is not the writer's own error alone (0.0123-0.0207).

sections.heading: What we learned that we did not know yesterday

entries.title: Constants from a superseded counter stayed in the public record
entries.what: FOUR_DOMAINS, the canon and the book kept the 2026-10-15 holding-energy values after the chain was commissioned on the per-opportunity count. Caught when IAMPerformance asked whether FOUR_DOMAINS was stale. Fixed at the canon; the old values are blocked patterns, and a push check refuses any book check whose number its chapter no longer prints.
